proposal.summary: PandoraFMS 7.0 NG <= 746 contains a persistent cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability via SNMP fields which allows injection of JavaScript that loads a remote script and can be used to create plugins and execute remote commands, leading to remote code execution.

AV.quote: By asking network administrator to scan SNMP device to trigger Cross Site Scripting(XSS)

PR.quote: By asking network administrator to scan SNMP device to trigger Cross Site Scripting(XSS)

UI.quote: By asking network administrator to scan SNMP device to trigger Cross Site Scripting(XSS)

C.quote: We can call a remote JavaScript file to execute arbitrary code to reach Remote Code Execution on PandoraFMS.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Verify the SNMP-sourced fields are properly sanitized/encoded on display and reproduce the report by providing crafted SNMP sysContact/sysLocation values; patch by adding output encoding and restricting inclusion of remote script tags, and add unit tests to prevent script injection.
